cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Nincada
cards.description: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes of dirt with its wings.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.description: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes of dirt with its wings.

cards.name: Bidoof
cards.description: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

cards.name: Bibarel
cards.description: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by the people nearby.

cards.name: Audino
cards.description: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: They great one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Ninjask
cards.description: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a trail.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Roselia
cards.description: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

cards.name: Roserade
cards.description: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

cards.name: Foongus
cards.description: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

cards.name: Magmortar
cards.description: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Blown by the seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.description: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.description: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through the water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, the can make wave in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.description: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

cards.name: Emolga
cards.description: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

cards.name: Dustox
cards.description: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

cards.name: Shedinja
cards.description: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

cards.name: Drifloon
cards.description: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

cards.name: Sigilyph
cards.description: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

cards.name: Trubbish
cards.description: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.description: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: It flies around the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.description: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It move by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.description: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

cards.name: Boldore
cards.description: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

cards.name: Gigalith
cards.description: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally are fired from its mouth.

cards.name: Throh
cards.description: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.description: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

cards.name: Silcoon
cards.description: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

cards.name: Stunfisk
cards.description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

cards.name: Stunky
cards.description: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

cards.name: Skuntank
cards.description: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes it steely body against others to fight over territory.

cards.name: Beautifly
cards.description: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Gible
cards.description: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Gabite
cards.description: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

cards.name: Cascoon
cards.description: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

cards.name: Garchomp
cards.description: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: It tends to bit everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It lives high among the treetops. It can us its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
